allOf.title: User ID
allOf.description: Identifies a registered user account. Assigned at sign-up and referenced by tokens, memberships, and audit trails.

allOf.title: Token ID
allOf.description: Identifies an access token or personal access token (PAT) issued to a user. Used to authenticate API requests to the registry.

allOf.title: Extension ID
allOf.description: Identifies a registered extension in the registry. An extension groups all published versions under a single handle, type, and name.
